title: Auto-advance from the code step
does: When on, build (or fix) finishes without stopping for /approve; docs and review run straight after. The review and pr gates stay yours.
options: go straight on to docs and review

title: Automatic go-back from review
does: When review finds something this severe or worse, the card goes back to build on its own. Anything below it, or go-back off, stops review for your decision.
options: never; review always stops for you

title: Automatic go-back rounds
does: How many times the card can go back on its own before review stops for you. Only used when go-back is on.

title: Comment on known Bureau issues
does: When a card hits a known Bureau issue, Bureau always counts it locally. When on, it also comments on the issue, which may be in a public repo: the card and what was hit for a Bureau card, only the date for a card from another repo. This is your standing approval for that one kind of comment.
